content.short: Lootex is a multi-chain NFT marketplace focused on gaming assets and collectibles, supporting trading of in-game NFTs on Mantle.
content.description: Lootex is a decentralized NFT marketplace with a strong focus on gaming assets, in-game items, and digital collectibles across multiple blockchain networks including Mantle. The platform provides game developers with white-label marketplace solutions and players with a dedicated destination for trading their gaming NFTs. Lootex's game-centric approach makes it particularly valuable for the growing Mantle gaming ecosystem, where players can buy, sell, and trade assets from various blockchain games in one unified marketplace.
